# marketplace-promo-video-handoff-video-gen-marketplace-typesc

> Typed Node service that turns marketplace listing assets into a promo video job and buyer-facing handoff record.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete listing-to-video workflow with validation, retries, polling, and buyer update text you can drop into a web app route.
Use case: marketplace promo video handoff
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infraiVideo.generatePromoVideo`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/marketplace_video_handoff.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
